description: This file defines a helper class for managing an SQLite database of notes within an Android application. It handles creating the database schema and upgrading it as needed.

classes.name: NotesDatabaseHelper
classes.description: A helper class extending SQLiteOpenHelper to manage database creation and version management for notes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the notes table in the database with columns for id, title, content, createdAt, and updatedAt.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Drops the existing notes table and recreates it when the database version is upgraded.
